routes.name: New York
routes.note: Real tracks follow the North Atlantic Tracks, re-drawn twice a day around the jet stream; westbound and eastbound flights use different ones.

routes.name: Los Angeles
routes.note: Real flights stay close to this great circle, over the North Sea, Greenland and Canada.

routes.name: Tokyo
routes.note: The great circle crosses Russia. European airlines have not been allowed into Russian airspace since 2022, so real flights detour, usually by more than an hour.

routes.name: Cape Town
routes.note: Real flights stay close to this line over Africa, as long as every overflight permit is in place.
